entries.finding: Kruse et al. 2019 (2019ApJS..244...11K), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname KRUSE_ET_AL__2019): P 7.12471 d; Livingston et al. 2018 (2018AJ....156..277L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname LIVINGSTON_ET_AL__2018): a/R* 14.45; Livingston et al. 2018 (2018AJ....156..277L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname LIVINGSTON_ET_AL__2018): inclination derived from its impact parameter 0.54 with its a/R* 14.45 (Winn 2010, eq. 7); No archive row states an eccentricity; the orbit is taken as circular; Kruse et al. 2019 (2019ApJS..244...11K), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname KRUSE_ET_AL__2019): transit mid-time 2457222.1244 BJD, taken as BJD_TDB; with its period, the row that predicts 2026-01-01 best (1 sigma 448 min); Display convention: transit photometry does not measure the orbit's position angle on the sky, so the ascending node is set at position angle 0 (celestial north)..
